parole.significato: opium (an addictive narcotic drug obtained from the dried juice of unripe pods of the opium poppy)
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish آفیون (afyon, “opium”). The form áfium may also have been a conscious word creation by the poet and military leader Count Miklós Zrínyi (1620–1664), following the example of Latin loanwords ending in the Latin -ium suffix.
